price_anchors.signal_close: Raw model path: each OHLC level is relative to the signal-date close.
price_anchors.predicted_entry_open: Published trade path: (1 + raw path) / (1 + predicted D1 open gap) - 1.
price_anchors.actual_entry_oracle: Diagnostic only: predicted future levels divided by the realized next open; not deployable.

score_variants.original: Registered path_value_v2 using the model-predicted entry-open denominator.
score_variants.signal_close_anchor: Path_value_v2 with the entry denominator neutralized at the signal close.
score_variants.board_bound_entry: Path_value_v2 after clipping the predicted D1 open gap to the regular board limit.
score_variants.actual_entry_oracle: Path_value_v2 using the realized next open only for attribution.

ranking_target: Realized path_value_v2 with the stored future tradability mask.
limitations: The audit is observational and does not retrain any checkpoint.
Regular board limits do not identify IPO no-limit periods; >20% diagnostics remain descriptive.
The 2026-07-21 latest signal has no realized future path at audit time and is assessed by internal consistency only.
